userStories.notes: Partial-cancel remains rejected on the completed 67-day audit. The strict frozen H audit is also complete on the only raw archive with bookTicker plus per-message dual-token L2: about three hours on one UTC day, 34 immutable bookTicker-first signals, one decision-time send candidate, and zero qualifying fills at 300/350/400/500 ms when a fill requires at least five shares on the direct token ladder at the frozen limit. At every delay, 30 signals had ask above limit, three had no valid limit, and the sole send lacked five surviving shares; EV/share and clustered CI are undefined, PnL is $0, and exact p=1. This audit is deliberately conservative and is not the full deployed retry path: it excludes trade fallback, retries after no-send/kill, mirrored liquidity, and sub-five-share partial fills. It is audit-only, not paper-gate eligible, and H is not promoted. Separately, the predeclared near-certain [0.95,0.99) side passed its unused 2025-09-15..2026-03-13 history segment at +2.43c/share (market-cluster t=6.74, 279 markets), but observed next-60-second trades prove pricing rather than our fill capacity. Its forward gate now uses receipt-time-only Binance inputs, the recorded market fee rate, a 500 ms ask, at least five shares, and reports the queue-unadjusted paper fill rate; it is not promoted until that forward gate and a bounded live calibration pass. The 100-rule zoo has also been corrected to freeze the first decision-time FAK limit and never replace a kill with a later fillable signal; a full 500 ms rerun is queued.
